items.title: A smooth morphism is covered by smooth morphisms of affine schemes with section and connected fibres
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma produces an etale covering of the source of a smooth morphism such that each member factors through an etale morphism to the base and is itself a smooth morphism of affine schemes with a section and geometrically connected fibres. The proof localises to obtain affine smooth pieces, then reorganises each piece so that the projection to an etale neighbourhood of the base is a smooth affine morphism with a section, and finally arranges geometric connectedness of the fibres. Producing simultaneously the section and the geometric connectedness of the fibres is the load-bearing part. Retained author proof at lines 10965-10994.
